chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Mansur ibn Yunus, from Abu Baseer, who said:
I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: 'No, by Allah! Allah will not accept anything from his obedience, upon his persistence upon something from his disobedience'.
ai.seo_question: Why does Allah not accept my good deeds if I keep sinning?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes a critical condition for the acceptance of worship: the absence of persistent sin (istiqra'). Shia scholars emphasize that this 'persistence' refers to a state of heart where one does not feel remorse or intend to repent, thereby creating a spiritual barrier that nullifies the reward of obedience. This teaching underscores the inseparable link between faith, consistent practice, and the internal state of humility before Allah.
